entries.title: Psalms 129:1
segments: <<A Song of Ascents.>>  Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up, Let Israel now say,

entries.title: Psalms 129:2
segments: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth up: Yet they have not prevailed against me.

entries.title: Psalms 129:3
segments: The plowers plowed upon my back; They made long their furrows.

entries.title: Psalms 129:4
segments: Jehovah is righteous: He hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 129:5
segments: Let them be put to shame and turned backward, All they that hate Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 129:6
segments: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, Which withereth before it  groweth up;

entries.title: Psalms 129:7
segments: Wherewith the reaper filleth not his hand, Nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

entries.title: Psalms 129:8
segments: Neither do they that go by say, The blessing of Jehovah be upon you; We bless you in the name of Jehovah.
